title: Sanofi: DTP, eRx to SanofiDirect Pharmacy, patient picks Cash Dispense

cards.name: Coverage confirmed by ABV in the CRM
cards.sees: The agent opens the Benefits Investigation stage in the CRM. The automated benefit verification confirms coverage from the details the patient confirmed, with no PA step.

cards.name: Patient chooses Copay or Cash Dispense
cards.sees: The patient sees two options on the price screen, Copay and Cash Dispense, and taps Cash Dispense. The cash dispense is filled by SanofiDirect Pharmacy.

demos.label: 2. DTP, Cash Dispense from SanofiDirect
demos.description: The HCP sends the eRx to SanofiDirect Pharmacy. The patient gets a text, confirms demographics, and the agent confirms coverage by ABV in the CRM. The patient picks Cash Dispense, pays in the patient app, sets shipment details, and SanofiDirect ships.

brand.name: Sanofi
documents: Sanofi & AssistRx PAP & DTC RFP Follow Up_11062026.pptx (SharePoint, RFP Completion Team). Not read: needs access.

winTheme: One eRx to SanofiDirect starts everything: a text to the patient, coverage confirmed by ABV in the CRM, and a cash dispense the patient pays and schedules in one app.
openQuestions: You said CoA_Copay is closer. But its menu has no cash option: Copay enrollment leads to Retail or Mail Order. CoA_DTP's menu has a self-pay card that pays through the manufacturer's pharmacy. Should Cash Dispense be a new `pricing` exit next to a Copay card, or a re-labeled self-pay exit?
The pharmacy that ships is hardcoded as 'CoAssist Pharmacy' in scenario content. Add SanofiDirect Pharmacy through `program.specialtyPharmacy` or `transferPartner` in the brand file?
Every pharmacy-covered exit runs a PA, and these steps have none. Add a covered-with-no-PA `bi` exit, or accept the AutoPA and PA-approved text?
Does the patient see the Copay option leading anywhere in this demo, or is it shown and skipped?
